title: OPERATOR CARD DROPS THE EMPTY RUN COUNT
why: Critic 62 (3 of 5): the line tonight 0 runs is noise, and a white ring on the amber button fights it. The line shows only with runs or a seed; the focus ring is amber.
now: The operator card shows no run count until there is one; the focus ring is amber.
